ideas.pitch: An automated data lineage and incident response platform tailored for cyber security compliance, leveraging automated agentic verification to detect and quarantine unauthorized data exfiltration attempts in real-time.
ideas.title: CyberShield DataTrace

ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge access control and compliance auditing tool that allows security analysts to prove data compliance without exposing underlying sensitive enterprise logs.
ideas.title: SecureNode ZK-Audit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the Cyber Security department organizers, this project introduces rigorous cryptographic verification which stands out among standard web CRUD apps at national level tech hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An automated bias detection and mitigation pipeline designed specifically for data science models, providing explainable metrics on fairness degradation over continuous data streams.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly appeals to the CSE (Data Science) organizing department by tackling the crucial real-world problem of algorithmic bias and model fairness in machine learning workflows.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines state-of-the-art agentic defense patterns with the specific domain expertise of the Cyber Security department hosting the event.
